props.author: Chase
props.text:
I like buying flushes..

Rule of thumb though
1. Buy flush, big profit / strong PA within minutes/hours or next day = great, small TP's and let run
2. Buy flush, stagnate PA / retracing towards the flush = not great, cuts and look for lower.

Doesn't always play out this way, but it keeps the profits big, losses small.
